title: Folinstall Wide Mouth Apothecary Jar with Lid, 0.5 Gallon Glass Jar for Kitchen Storage and Laundry Room Organization, 72 oz Clear Glass Container for Cookie, Candy, Sugar, Flour, Nuts
description:
About this item
Healthy and No Smell - Glass is a healthier choice over plastic storage. Glass does not discolor, retain smells, or leach chemicals into food
Sturdy and Easy to Clean - This candy jar increases thickness for added durability and stability. What’s more, you can wash this cookie jar with warm water, and wipe them with a damp cloth
Clear Glass Jar - Wide mouth glass canister allows the contents of the jar to be easily seen without removing the lid
Wide Mouth Design - The canning jar features a large mouth (4.7 inches) that makes filling and storing preserves with ease, so you don’t have to worry about spilling sauces or pickled vegetables
Decorate Your Kitchen - This apothecary jar with lid has a contemporary design with a beautiful display, it stores conveniently and looks great on any counter, party, bathroom vanity, dresser, or buffet table, a beautiful complement to most kitchen decorating
Multi-Function Food Storage Jar - 0.56 gallon(2300ML) halloween candy jar is great for many uses. Can be used for canning or pickling. Also suited for dry goods such as cereal, candy, legumes, pasta, and much more. Not only does it allow you to store different amounts of food, but it looks visually appealing when displayed on a counter or shelf

(I cook a lot if you cant tell ) And they look nice and sharp on the counter. If I need another one.. I'm buying this again. thank you, D.This is a great little cookie jar! Just the perfect size. Thank you so much.

It seemed like good quality but with minimal use it cracked in two places so out of the money as I just noticed it and the return window has closed. Would be nice if seller would make good on it. It was stored in my pantry empty. Not used much.It was kinda a small but large mouth! It held 5 pounds of sugar which is very good! It was made very nicely very durable which I am very happy with. Love the lid that came with it easy to clean . Love this productAir tight. No stale cookies or candyI use this jar for my sourdough starter. I removed the plastic band so it wouldn't have an airtight lid. It seems really sturdy. Its easy to clean and keep clean. It's perfect for large amounts of starter.nice heavy weight. good seal on top too.I now have two of these jars. The first was for granola, kept on the counter top. Discovered my brown sugar, wrapped tightly in the original plastic bag and placed in a plastic container with, I thought, a tight fitting lid, had turned to stone. Good purchase.Arrived fast and packaged very well. The Jar is a good size and it’s Beautiful I love it 😊Perfect for my brown sugar and also bought one for my laundry room, to hold Clorox packets! Perfect, tight seal! Nice quality glass, came in perfect condition! Going to buy a few more!
reviews_1s: I bought 2 of these jars from “second chance” sellers, meaning the jars were returned from someone else. I read the reviews… I wanted to give them a home! The glass is great! Overall, unfortunately, these jars are just plain awful.This is not a half a gallon as promisedVery misleading. This is very cheaply made the plastic”secure” piece does not even fot right. Lid n plastic piece are separate . Does not seal at all. This is terrible. Sorry to say it but I will not recommend this at all. I wasted my money. I can’t use it. Maybe for a planter without lid?Not sure about material choice for the seal. It will not hold up. I do not know what the 2 hole punches are for, but the mess up the aesthetic of the jar lid. Today, my husband picked it up to move it closer to him so he could take the lid off and the whole jar separated completely from the base, spilling the candy everywhere.So disappointing. These glass canisters have a very visible seam that cuts down the middle "and" and silicone gasket is very thin, rippled and difficult to secure onto the top of the canister itself...no bueno!Okay I’m sure this is a great product and it looks really nice, and I originally purchased it to store 5lbs of coffee beans because they would look so nice on the shelf with this jar. I attached pictures of the hair (man i even feel like the “theres a hair in my food” lady just writing this lol). I don’t want to be THAT person, but accompanied with the smell im not gonna use this and will likely return it :(The seal is cheap, hard plastic and keeps curling backwards!
